verdict.rationale: Docs show the Customer Agent can connect to any API-based tool (Stripe, internal endpoints) so it can, in principle, pull live account/order data rather than rely only on static knowledge articles, and knowledge/tools are shared across agents via connections. However, there's no explicit example or case study showing the agent actually surfacing plan, order status, or account history in a real answer — the evidence only proves general tool-connectivity capability, not a demonstrated live-data resolution flow. Missing for 10: concrete example/case study of an answer pulling live order/account data, and confirmation this is used by default rather than requiring manual tool setup.
